version: blocks-express-test answer key P v1 (profiled block agent, slice P3)

scoring.f1: set-F1 on atom type names after removing ignore_atoms from the produced set; per brief the score is the MAX over alternatives (each alternative is a full expected set). Empty produced set = F1 0 (a refusal is not an atom choice) except where the brief's check is b8_trap.
scoring.ignore_note: Container/text atoms are neither credited nor penalised (DECISION D3). The B4 catalogue contains none of them, so they can only appear in FULL.
scoring.compiled_vs_raw: Primary score uses atoms from the compiled reply (empty when the compiler/validator rejects). A secondary raw score uses constructor names/components found in the raw reply text, so a rejected reply still shows what it tried to pick.

B3.rule: block_robot OR motion_bricks; PASS also requires NO invented fields (same raw-text rule as stage 1, against the P3 catalogue). base=red on block_robot is a real field: flagged semantic_misuse, not invented.

B5.rule: motion_bricks (the only brick atom in the slice); validator verdict recorded for a bricks list, named shape recorded as such.

B7.rule: REFUSE: real LDraw parts are out of scope for the block agent. PASS = reply compiles to zero components or is text only. Any component = fail. A compile rejection is NOT a pass (recorded as rejected_unknown_component for information).

B8.rule: REFUSE: not a toy-brick model. Same rule as B7.

note: Condition P tests COMPLIANCE with the profile (partly by design), not discovery. Matching briefs = B1-B6, refusal briefs = B7, B8.
